content.rendered:
The Archer Glen Kinder Open House for Kindergarteners starting school in September for the 2023-2024 school year will take place on Thursday, March 2nd. The Open House will be held in the Archer Glen gym. Doors will open at 3:30 pm and the event will run until 6:00 pm. Entry to Kinder Open House will be from the covered play area off the parking lot. Here is the link to sign up for a time slot for Open House – LINK.

Registration for our incoming Kindergarten class is available online using the link below. Incoming Kindergarten students must turn 5 prior to September 1. Registering early helps the school and district start planning for the fall.

Online Kindergarten Registration

During online registration, new families will create a Sherwood ParentVUE account. Parents of current and former Sherwood students will log in with their existing ParentVUE account. Please call the Archer Glen front office at 503-825-5100 or email Judy Morales at jmorales@sherwood.k12.or.us if you have any questions.

Paper Registration

Families are also welcome to register using paper registration. Paper registration packets can be picked up from the Archer Glen front office.

The Welcome New Kindergarten Families newsletter is a special edition newsletter for any families with an incoming Kindergarten student that will be joining us next year.
